rows: I get along well with my classmates. 我和同学相处融洽
It's hard to get rid of a bad habit. 很难改掉坏习惯
I got used to the weather. 我习惯了这天气
He took part in the contest. 他参加了比赛
She takes care of her sister. 她照顾妹妹
I made up my mind to study abroad. 我决心出国
You've made great progress. 你进步很大

blocks.text: get used to / be used to 后接名词或动名词（doing）；used to do 意为“过去常常”，注意区分。take part in（参加活动）与 join（加入组织/团体）不同。

blocks.label: 例1
blocks.text: I have got used to ______ (get) up early.
solution: be/get used to 后接动名词。

exercises.q: 填空：He took part ______ the sports meeting.（参加）
填空：We should get ______ of pollution.（除掉）
填空：I get ______ well with my friends.（相处）
填空：She made ______ her mind to win.（下决心）

rows: She came up with a good idea. 她想出个好主意
My dream came true. 我的梦想实现了
Go on with your work. 继续你的工作
Turn down the radio, please. 请把收音机调小声
It turned out to be true. 结果证明是真的
Don't put off till tomorrow. 别拖到明天
I can't put up with the noise. 我受不了噪音

blocks.text: put off = delay（推迟）后接名词/doing；turn down 既可“调低音量”，也可“拒绝(邀请/请求)”。多义短语要结合语境判断。

blocks.label: 例1
blocks.text: We had to put ______ the meeting because of the rain.

exercises.q: 填空：He came ______ with a clever plan.（想出）
填空：My wish finally came ______ .（实现）
填空：I can't put ______ with his rudeness.（忍受）
填空：Please turn ______ the music; it's too loud.（调低）

items.title: 形容词 + 介词固定搭配

rows: She is good at English. 她擅长英语
I'm interested in history. 我对历史感兴趣
We are proud of our country. 我们为祖国自豪
He is afraid of dogs. 他怕狗
The city is famous for its food. 这城市以美食闻名
This is different from that. 这个和那个不同
The room is full of people. 房间挤满了人

blocks.text: be famous for（以…闻名，后接原因）≠ be famous as（作为…而闻名，后接身份）。介词后接名词或动名词。

exercises.q: 填介词：I'm interested ______ music.
填介词：They are proud ______ their team.
填介词：Beijing is famous ______ the Great Wall.
填介词：My idea is different ______ yours.

items.title: 动词 + 介词固定搭配

rows: It depends on the weather. 这取决于天气
This book belongs to me. 这书是我的
How do you deal with stress? 你怎么应对压力？
I look forward to seeing you. 我期待见到你
Pay attention to your spelling. 注意拼写
She takes pride in her work. 她以工作为荣
He succeeded in passing. 他成功通过了

blocks.text: look forward to / pay attention to / get used to 中的 to 是介词，后接动名词(doing)，不是动词原形——这是高频陷阱。

blocks.label: 例1
blocks.text: I'm looking forward to ______ (hear) from you.
solution: to 是介词，后接动名词。

exercises.q: 填介词：Success depends ______ hard work.
填介词：Please pay attention ______ the road.
填空：He succeeded in ______ (win) the game.（填正确形式）
填介词：This pen belongs ______ Tom.

rows: It takes sb some time to do
It took me an hour to do it. 我花了一小时做
He was so tired that he slept. 他累得睡着了
It's too heavy to lift. 太重搬不动
She is not only kind but also clever. 她既善良又聪明
He is as tall as me. 他和我一样高
I'd rather walk than wait. 我宁愿走也不等
I can't help laughing. 我忍不住笑

blocks.text: so...that 后接从句，such...that 中 such 修饰名词；too...to 表否定含义（太…不能），不能再加 not。can't help doing = 忍不住。

blocks.label: 例1
blocks.text: It ______ me two hours to finish the homework.
solution: It takes sb time to do，过去时用 took。

exercises.q: 填空：He was ______ tired ______ he couldn't move.（如此…以至于）
填空：The box is too heavy ______ (carry).（太重搬不动，填不定式）
填空：She is not only beautiful ______ also kind.（不仅…而且）
填空：I can't help ______ (cry) at the sad film.（忍不住哭）
